title: claude-blog: AI Writes & SEO-Optimizes Your Blog Posts
description:
claude-blog is a free, self-hosted tool that writes and optimizes blog posts for you. It scores every draft, checks for Google readiness, and works with Claude Code. A great alternative to paid platforms like Jasper.
